searchText: I am gonna need some help on a specific hive test, namely: `Invalid PayloadAttributes: Missing BeaconRoot (Cancun)` (note: not the `(Syncing)` variant). What happens in hive is that: `INFO (Invalid PayloadAttributes: Missing BeaconRoot): Sending EngineForkchoiceUpdated (Syncing=false) with invalid payload attributes: Missing BeaconRoot` (it sends `forkchoiceUpdateV3` with `parentBlockBeaconRoot=null`) This results in an error message: `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":24,"error":{"code":-32602,"message":"invalid argument 1 for key 'parentBeaconBlockRoot': argument must be a hex string"}}` Then, it calls `eth_getBlockByNumber` to get the latest block. We return the previous head block (so have not updated), but this throws and fails the test. Nethermind seems to pass this test: https://hivecancun.ethdevops.io/viewer.html?suiteid=1697425804-6cd4fd262221c2c5b25514bd190cdeb2.json&suitename=engine-cancun&testid=197&showtestlog=1#L123 It does throw with same error code as we do, but it seems to update the latest block hash to the one provided by the faulty FCU. So, once `eth_getBlockByNumber` is called on latest block, it returns the block with the hash provided by the faulty FCU. (This seems wrong to me). CC <@&652918665943056397> <@892053833121923094> <@755913785620824175> <@&688101493978562687> seems to behave the same. https://hivecancun.ethdevops.io/viewer.html?suiteid=1697427763-608e891ea04220a12235f686f035a4db.json&suitename=engine-cancun&testid=197&showtestlog=1 If no `parentBeaconBlockRoot` is provided this is is invalid FCU, right? So it should reject this hash? This is the problem that we have recently discussed in various channels (<#892088344438255616> and <#804019759934078987> ). The spec doesn't say it explicitly but it is expected that the forkchoice state if valid is applied disregarding payloadAttributes validity. excerpts.content:
I am gonna need some help on a specific hive test, namely: `Invalid PayloadAttributes: Missing BeaconRoot (Cancun)` (note: not the `(Syncing)` variant).

What happens in hive is that:

`INFO (Invalid PayloadAttributes: Missing BeaconRoot): Sending EngineForkchoiceUpdated (Syncing=false) with invalid payload attributes: Missing BeaconRoot`

(it sends `forkchoiceUpdateV3` with `parentBlockBeaconRoot=null`)

This results in an error message:

`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":24,"error":{"code":-32602,"message":"invalid argument 1 for key 'parentBeaconBlockRoot': argument must be a hex string"}}`

Then, it calls `eth_getBlockByNumber` to get the latest block. We return the previous head block (so have not updated), but this throws and fails the test.

Nethermind seems to pass this test: https://hivecancun.ethdevops.io/viewer.html?suiteid=1697425804-6cd4fd262221c2c5b25514bd190cdeb2.json&suitename=engine-cancun&testid=197&showtestlog=1#L123

It does throw with same error code as we do, but it seems to update the latest block hash to the one provided by the faulty FCU. So, once `eth_getBlockByNumber` is called on latest block, it returns the block with the hash provided by the faulty FCU. (This seems wrong to me). 

CC <@&652918665943056397> <@892053833121923094> <@755913785620824175> 

<@&688101493978562687> seems to behave the same. https://hivecancun.ethdevops.io/viewer.html?suiteid=1697427763-608e891ea04220a12235f686f035a4db.json&suitename=engine-cancun&testid=197&showtestlog=1

If no `parentBeaconBlockRoot` is provided this is is invalid FCU, right? So it should reject this hash?

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: This is the problem that we have recently discussed in various channels (<#892088344438255616>  and <#804019759934078987> ). The spec doesn't say it explicitly but it is expected that the forkchoice state if valid is applied disregarding payloadAttributes validity. There is a pending fix to the Engine API spec
